The Ledger Room — Dusty manifests confirm the pattern: each lost wagon's last entry reads the same clerk's hand, 'paid the deep toll,' followed by nothing at all.

The Sunken Bridge — The old stone bridge has slumped into the current, leaving only a treacherous ford and a few rotten rope-ends swinging over the gap.

The Abandoned Camp — Wagon frames lie stripped to their bones. Small clawed tracks circle the firepits and vanish into a burrow beneath an uprooted willow.
The Ancient Toll-Stone — A crossroads stone, older than the League itself, is carved with a riddle in flowing script. Beneath it, a mechanism waits, patient as the river.
Ambush Beneath the Willow — The burrow erupts with kobolds defending their spoils, a goblin outrider barking orders from the treeline.

The Barrow Wight's Guard — Past the ferry landing, a sunken barrow guards the river's true crossing. A wight rises from the silt, zombies shambling at its call.
